items.name: vv
items.title: vv design system index
items.description: Every item in the vv registry, its tier and when to use it.
items.docs: Start here. Read the items this index names with `npx shadcn view ./registry/r/<item>.json` from web/.

items.name: vv-theme
items.title: vv theme tokens
items.description: Every design-system token (colour roles, type, spacing and sizes, radius, shadow, motion) in web/src/ui/tokens.css.
items.docs: Use only the utility classes these tokens generate. Which role each colour plays and which step to use where: web/registry/rules/foundations.md (item vv-rules).

items.name: vv-rules
items.title: vv design-system rules
items.description: The usage rules of the vv design system, one file per tier.
items.docs: Read foundations.md before choosing a colour, a type step, a spacing step, a radius or a shadow, and components.md before choosing or composing a component.

items.docs: Predates the design system; its usage rules arrive with the components tier (docs/design-docs/design-system.md).

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Actions: one default (primary) per area, then secondary, outline, ghost, destructive and link, in sizes sm, default, lg, icon-sm and icon.
items.docs: Usage rules: web/registry/rules/components.md#button (item vv-rules).

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Turns one option on or off in a form or a selection; has an indeterminate state.
